claim: The selected six-distance 25% retained-flip recipe exceeds raw-coordinate 100% retained-flip J in the six size-by-seed cells on the same evaluation pool.
allowed_wording: Finite-budget retained-label comparison after mining the full flip pool; six-distance 25% exceeds raw 100% in all six displayed size-by-seed cells.
The 1,229 quartets from 250 eligible parents are the shared evaluation pool; N and 4N are training-size conditions and seeds are model initializations.
forbidden_wording: 75% fewer oracle queries
N and 4N are independent dataset replications
The three seeds are independent task replications

denominator.evaluation: 1,229 quartets / 250 eligible parents from 512 sampled parents
denominator.comparison_cells: 2 training sizes x 3 model seeds = 6 displayed comparisons
denominator.oracle_ledger: N mined 1,534 flips in 2,801 attempts; 25% retains 383. 4N mined 6,390 flips in 11,955 attempts; 25% retains 1,597. Query attempts are paid before the retained-label subset is selected.

recomputation: The per-seed table and parent-bootstrap summaries are available in the cited artifacts. Bootstrap resampling clusters parents but retains all quartets; the point estimate is row-weighted. No cross-seed or cross-size pooling was used in this audit.
limitations: Learning-rate selection is on static/single development BCE, not evaluation J.
The evaluation parents are shared across all six comparisons.
Input dimensions differ slightly, so parameter counts are not exactly matched.
fixes: Keep the table caption's explicit statement that this is not oracle-query savings.
Keep parent and quartet denominators visible and describe seeds as model initializations.

claim: Warm-start continuation adds 648 training runs and reports paired interaction contrasts on the same held-out parent pool.
allowed_wording: The continuation factorial contains 432 warm-start and 216 convergence-robust arms, with all cells retained.
The interaction intervals are per-seed model comparisons on the same 1,229-quartet / 250-parent bank.
forbidden_wording: 648 independent replications
A pooled bootstrap over seeds and parents
A universal continuation benefit across every dose and scale

denominator.bootstrap: parent-cluster bootstrap per comparison; seeds remain separate

recomputation: The stored paired JSON preserves each size, seed, dose and start condition. This audit did not pool those nested comparisons into new independent observations.
limitations: The same parent bank is reused across model arms and initialization seeds.
The tested optimizers, dose levels and widths do not establish a general continuation law.
fixes: Present interactions as conditional, per-cell evidence; retain the reported exceptions.

claim: The tested typed model remains below six-distance under matched parameter count and the tested optimizer recipe grid, but the result is bounded to the tested family and the exact effects vary with thread count.
allowed_wording: In the primary run, six-flip minus typed_m-flip is positive for all three seeds in T1 and T2; parent-paired intervals exclude zero.
The matched control tests one typed width and six learning-rate/step recipes selected on training objective, not evaluation J.
A separate two-thread rerun preserves all six positive directions but changes the point estimates.
forbidden_wording: A proof that relational representations or the architecture class cannot work
Numerically thread-invariant effect sizes
Causal attribution to architecture independent of feature distribution and depth

denominator.recipe_grid: 3 learning rates x 2 step counts per architecture; train-objective selection

recomputation: Primary six-minus-typed_m point differences are T1 0.513583/0.528634/0.486050 and T2 0.731339/0.700552/0.755155. The two-thread output gives T1 0.524963/0.521659/0.448238 and T2 0.740924/0.690967/0.731920. Each set retains positive direction; exact numerical agreement is absent.
limitations: The two runs use different thread counts and reduction orders.
Parameter count does not match depth, allocation or optimization geometry.
There is no independent development bank for this O02 comparison; recipe selection is train-only.
fixes: Keep the primary-run estimates identified as such and disclose the two-thread sensitivity values or range.
Retain the tested-recipe and non-architecture-proof boundary.

claim: The preregistered primary prediction that head-level flip supervision would act most on J failed in one of eight cells; the secondary prediction that J-star moved less than J held in all eight.
allowed_wording: The prospective diagnostic supports P2 in these eight cells but does not support the primary P1 prediction.
The sole P1 miss is T1/raw_clean; the full primary verdict is MISS.
The preregistration preceded the result write by 85 seconds.
forbidden_wording: The decomposition is a validated general prospective diagnostic
Causal mechanism established
Independent fresh-bank confirmation

denominator.cells: 2 tasks x 4 encoder conditions = 8; 3 model seeds per cell

recomputation: From the stored per-cell seed-mean deltas, P1 is true in 7/8 and P2 in 8/8. The primary verdict is therefore MISS. The T1/raw_clean deltas are S=+0.0188, J=-0.0146, J*=+0.0120.
limitations: The tasks, evaluation banks and frozen trunks were generated earlier; novelty is relative to the previous readout reanalysis.
J-star is an evaluation-label oracle diagnostic, not deployable accuracy.
The football echo identifies a domain boundary only; S/J/J-star is undefined for the 117 scenes with no feasible candidate.
fixes: Replace the current appendix statement that the prospective test and downstream echo were not run.
Use diagnostic / bounded language and state the primary miss before the secondary success.

claim: The d09fresh665 single-edit bank overlaps exact mined-flip training states for 4N and 16N models; a new endpoint-scoring sensitivity finds small descriptive accuracy shifts, while the D09 quartet denominator remains unchanged.
allowed_wording: 4N models exclude their 163 exact-overlap eids; 16N models exclude their 761 exact-overlap eids, separately.
Across the 21 affected checkpoints, row-weighted single-endpoint accuracy changes from -0.109 to +0.010 percentage points after the pool-specific exclusion.
The D09 quartet result is not re-estimated here; the existing 236-quartet bank has zero exact and zero near state overlaps under the audited criterion.
forbidden_wording: The single-edit sensitivity re-estimates D09 quartet J
4N and 16N should both drop the union of all 761 eids
The overlap invalidates the quartet results

denominator.4N: 163 eids / 30 parents; 126,132 retained rows per model
denominator.16N: 761 eids / 127 parents; 125,534 retained rows per model
denominator.forward_count: 2,652,195 endpoint states; Sx start states not separately scored
denominator.quartets: 236; exact overlap 0, near overlap 0; denominator kept at 236

recomputation: CPU-only scoring of the existing Sx+Se single-edit endpoints, 4 threads, completed in 3.57 seconds. All hits are label-flip states. Per-pool exclusion was checked per checkpoint; 4N and 16N lists share 163 eids. Across models, parent-equal accuracy changes range -0.252 to -0.002 pp. No confidence interval was computed.
limitations: This is a descriptive single-endpoint accuracy diagnostic, not an existing D09 claim metric or a D09 quartet reanalysis.
Rows are nested within 512 parents; no inferential interval is claimed.
Only the 21 checkpoints with exact overlap were scored.
fixes: Replace any general wording that implies the single-edit sensitivity was historically available; cite the new overlay result.
Keep quartet rows in the denominator and describe the single-bank sensitivity separately.

claim: Natural strict E is rare within the registered 0.2-second forward contract-cap window; guided/random search constructibility is a different quantity.
allowed_wording: Natural E occurs in 8/1,449 situations (0.55%), 8/162 events (4.94%) and 10/7,117 frame pairs (0.14%) in this three-match sample.
Controlled search constructs E in 670/1,449 candidate opportunities (46.2%); this is not the natural incidence rate.
forbidden_wording: 46.2% natural E incidence
E is infeasible in football
Geometric oracle labels are observed pass-success outcomes

denominator.search: 1,449 sampled controlled candidate opportunities; 155 eligible observed selected passes

recomputation: The stored summary gives 8/1,449=0.005521, 8/162=0.049383, 10/7,117=0.001405, and 670/1,449=0.4624. The numerator 670 is a search result, not a natural-event count.
limitations: Three existing matches and a 0.2-second window/cap define the sample.
No pass-success labels are available; labels are geometric oracle outcomes.
fixes: Add the natural rate beside the search rate in the appendix and name each unit and denominator.

claim: Feasible-only evaluation masks a large portion of the scene universe with no feasible candidate; all-scene coverage is below the dev target and is not an equal-coverage deployment comparison.
allowed_wording: Of 256 scenes, 117 (45.7%) have all 49 candidates infeasible; the 213-scene evaluation partition contains 96 feasible and 117 infeasible scenes.
The existing 96-scene table is conditional on oracle feasibility; full-scene eval coverage at the nominal 0.5 dev target is 0.1455-0.3239.
The threshold policy was selected on development scenes; differing evaluation coverage makes quality contrasts policy extrapolations, not equal-coverage effects.
forbidden_wording: The decomposition explains the 117/256 infeasible share
The deployed policy achieves the dev target coverage
Real decision utility or deployment performance

denominator.infeasible_share: 117/256=45.7% of the full universe; 117/213=54.9% of evaluation

recomputation: The all-scene summary reports 256 total, 139 feasible and 117 infeasible; the held-out split is 213 scenes with 96 feasible and 117 infeasible. These counts establish that conditioning the published 96-scene table removes the infeasible evaluation stratum.
limitations: The reward/cost scale is illustrative and the oracle feasibility label is not a field outcome.
The deployment analysis reuses a synthetic scene universe and does not establish real-world utility.
fixes: Add the 117/256 and 117/213 counts and full-scene coverage range beside the conditional 96-scene table.
State that the S/J/J-star decomposition cannot score scenes with no feasible candidate.
